Walking is very difficult for me so I asked about parking. Receptionist had no idea other than, "there should be parking". Now I know parking at Park Parade isn't perfect but I can usually find a spot in the lane etc. I explained that if I got to the other surgery and couldn't park close enough, I'd have to leave. At that, nurse appointments magically appeared and I was even given a choice of day and time.
After my blood test, I received a text, telling me to book an appointment with the nurse, to discuss my results.  The earliest TELEPHONE appointment was in FOUR WEEKS time.  Four weeks to tell me a number they could have put in the original text.
I am so sad this is happening in a once busy, happy, practice.
